items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I tell you a lady, let's used to be with us, just as regular as we had finger to the toe, and she got to be a big star, Martha Ray.

ctx.x: I just wanted to do some of the ones who came around and sat in.

Well, there's so many of them, Dick, I'm telling you, he used to pile in there, man. Of course I tell you what made these to come there, see. Like, take the movie stars like George Ralph, and Harry James, and all them fellas, you know, they'd be in town playing a theater or something, and that breakfast man, they'd be there that morning. And they'd all the people that's come see them, meet them, you know. That's why that happened. Now, I tell you a lady, let's used to be with us, just as regular as we had finger…
She'd come to the Golden Leather?
